tasks.description: Create custom field 'Company Address' on Account object
Add 'Company Address' field to default Account page layout

Configure Field-Level Security for 'Company Address' field: grant Read/Edit access to System Administrator profile; leave other profiles with default visibility (visible and editable) unless business requires restriction
Deploy the custom field, page layout modification, and FLS settings to sandbox environment for testing

Test the 'Company Address' field in sandbox: verify field appears on Account record page, can be populated with up to 255 characters, is accessible via SOQL/REST/SOAP APIs, and FLS restrictions work as configured
Deploy the custom field, page layout modification, and FLS settings to production environment after successful sandbox testing
